configuration_notes: Add only exact HTTPS pages whose current terms permit automated factual-name extraction.
Each source requires id, url, terms_url, terms_reviewed=true, permission_note and format=html_names or json_names.
An example source shape is documented in DISCOVERY.md; no breeder is enabled by default.
No recursive crawling, images, descriptions, popularity ranking or automatic trusted-data promotion.
Granthuriums, NSE Tropicals, Carnivero and their subdomains are prohibited for automated requests. Local factual citation imports remain allowed.
